$comment: The site config of this repository (CI.md of the template, "The site config"). The Pages workflow deploys this site from main, and a job of ci.yml checks it on each pull request.
build:
if git fetch -q origin site-data; then
  branch="$(mktemp -d)"
  git archive FETCH_HEAD | tar -x -C "$branch"
  node --no-warnings packages/site/scripts/overlay.ts "$branch" packages/site/data
fi
(cd packages/packing && node --no-warnings bench/snapshot.ts releases)
pnpm --filter @packing/site run check:data
pnpm --filter @packing/site run build
